title: WAF-2: A Consortium-Ledger Trust Registry for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi Roaming — research artefact
description:
Reproducibility artefact for the paper A Consortium-Ledger Trust Registry for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi Roaming: Design, Formal Analysis, and Measured Cost.

Contains: the Solidity consortium registry; five ProVerif models (secrecy, authorisation, injective agreement, forward secrecy, key-compromise-impersonation resistance, revocation under device compromise, and one model that fails by design to document an inherent limitation); a deterministic EVM gas benchmark; and a harness that stands up live 4- to 13-node go-ethereum Clique consortia and measures revocation propagation across them.

All benchmarks are deterministic and every figure in the paper is regenerated by the included scripts.
notes: Supported by the Ministry of Higher Education (MoHE) Malaysia through the Fundamental Research Grant Scheme, FRGS/1/2021/ICT07/UTAR/02/3.
